prompt:
A photorealistic 3D architectural cutaway render of a single-storey house with the front wall removed, viewed straight on at eye level. Professional architectural visualisation quality, like a building-products catalogue render.

The cross-section exposes, from top to bottom as clearly separated layers:

ROOF — tiled roof covering over timber rafters and a visible truss structure, with battens and underlay visible at the cut edge.
CEILING — ceiling joists with insulation batts laid between them, plasterboard ceiling below.
ROOM — a furnished open-plan living space. A fabric sofa and low timber coffee table on the left, a window in the left wall. On the right, a fitted kitchen: lower cabinets with a stone counter, a built-in oven with a dark glass door, an upper wall cabinet, a sink with a tap, and a tall stainless fridge at the far right end of the run. The cabinets sit on a recessed kickboard with a clear shadow gap beneath them.
WALLS — both left and right exterior walls cut open to show timber studs, insulation batts between them, a clearly visible horizontal bottom plate where the wall meets the floor, and exterior cladding on the outside face. A skirting board runs along the base of the interior wall faces.
FLOOR — timber floorboards with visible board seams running across the room.
SUBFLOOR — plywood sheeting over timber floor joists, with insulation batts between the joists.
CRAWLSPACE — an open void beneath, with concrete block piers supporting the floor structure, insulated flexible ductwork running through it, and a plastic vapour barrier laid over bare earth at the base.

MATERIALS: materially accurate and textured — real timber grain, fibreglass insulation with visible fibre, concrete aggregate in the piers, fabric weave on the sofa, brushed stainless on the appliances, stone counter surface. Natural colours: warm timber, pink or yellow insulation, grey concrete, white plasterboard.
LIGHTING: soft, even, neutral studio lighting from the front. Gentle ambient occlusion in recesses. No harsh shadows, no dramatic contrast, no coloured light. Everything clearly visible, nothing lost in shadow.
COMPOSITION: pure white background. The house fills the frame horizontally and is centred, roof near the top, crawlspace near the bottom. Square-on orthographic projection so every layer reads as a clean horizontal band across the full width. No ground shadow, no landscaping, no sky.
NO text, NO labels, NO dimension lines, NO arrows, NO watermarks, NO people.
4:3 landscape, high resolution, sharp detail throughout.
